title: [YouPass Collect] - Australian retail comparison: department vs online stores 2011
prompt: The table shows information about department stores and online stores in Australia in 2011. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The table compares department stores and online stores in Australia across four key business metrics in 2011.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, online stores vastly outnumbered traditional department stores in terms of quantity. However, despite having significantly fewer businesses, department stores generated comparable sales revenue and profit to their online counterparts.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the scale of operations, there were 368 online stores operating in Australia, which was more than five times higher than the figure for department stores, at just 67. In terms of sales revenue, however, the two retail formats performed similarly, with online stores earning AUD 13,400 compared to AUD 12,700 for department stores, a difference of only AUD 700.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for profitability, online stores recorded a profit of AUD 863, marginally higher than department stores at AUD 807. Finally, growth rates showed a similar pattern, with online stores expanding at 0.6%, slightly ahead of the 0.4% growth seen in department stores.
